experience.description: Founder & CEO of QueryFlow, an AI startup that turns operational problems into digital solutions. Building Mantra—a product for exams, assessment, events, and analytics.

Designed and implemented a scalable multi-tenant architecture supporting 10+ tenants with isolated data and configuration. Optimized multi-tenant queries and data access patterns, reducing response time by up to 40% and improving system reliability.

Presented technical solutions and project progress to clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment with business requirements. Refactored over 20 legacy modules, improving maintainability and reducing technical debt.

Optimized frontend query performance, improving loading and interaction times by 60% across student and administrative portals. Led development of enrollment, re-enrollment, and score reporting for a system used by over 250k students across East Java.
Designed DRM-based protection against illegal downloading and screen sharing, resulting in an 80% reduction in piracy across tests on 8 browsers.

Developed core features for Spectra, a web platform supporting PLN internal operations. Implemented 13 of 30+ key pages including ULP, UP3, Employee, and Parent dashboards with responsive, maintainable UI.
Built a scalable HOC for RBAC in a medical app with dynamic route protection using a role-permission matrix (5 roles, 20+ rules).

projects.title: RAGForge

projects.title: DiLLeMA
projects.description: Final-year thesis: extensible framework for distributed LLM inference over GPU clusters using Ray and vLLM, with modular RAG pipeline integration for high-throughput workloads.

projects.title: Sorting Algorithm Visualization
projects.description: Interactive visualization of 17 sorting algorithms with D3.js and Next.js to make algorithm movement easier to understand.

infoPanels.title: What roles are you targeting?
infoPanels.content: Software engineering roles spanning backend, fullstack, and AI/LLM systems—especially teams shipping production RAG, distributed inference, or high-traffic platforms. I also lead as CEO of QueryFlow (queryflow.id), and bring 4+ years of delivery experience including SPMB Jatim at 250k+ users.

infoPanels.title: What is your AI / LLM depth?
infoPanels.content: I build RAG systems with LangChain and ChromaDB (RAGForge) and distributed LLM inference with Ray and vLLM (DiLLeMA, published in SoftwareX). I care about production readiness: Docker, dependency injection, and measurable throughput.

infoPanels.title: How do you prove you can scale?
infoPanels.content: At SPMB Jawa Timur I improved frontend query loading and interaction times by 60% and owned enrollment features for 250k+ students. At Techflouu I cut multi-tenant response time by up to 40% across 10+ tenants.

infoPanels.title: What about your academic foundation?
infoPanels.content: Bachelor of Informatics at ITS (GPA 3.61) and Master of Informatics ongoing. I am a research assistant in distributed systems, a teaching assistant for microservices, and an author on SoftwareX and IEEE ONCON publications.
